title: TraceQuery: learning what to recompute from full-denoising trajectory in diffusion language models
abstract: arXiv:2610.33008v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) enable flexible generation through iterative masked denoising, but incur substantial inference cost because token representations are repeatedly recomputed across denoising steps. Existing cache-based methods reduce this cost by reusing intermediate results across denoising steps and recomputing only a subset of positions at each step, chosen either on a fixed schedule or by heuristic signals of change. Our trajectory experiments instead point to decoding trajectory as the more relevant quantity. Cached generation remains accurate when it stays close to the full-denoising trajectory, with errors concentrated around unmask-order deviations and reduced as longer reference prefixes are recovered. This suggests a more direct principle: limiting representation error helps, but keeping generation on the full-denoising trajectory is a more direct route to accurate decoding. translated_title: TraceQuery：在扩散语言模型中从全去噪轨迹学习需要重新计算的内容
translated_abstract: 扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）通过迭代式的掩码去噪实现灵活的文本生成，但由于token表示在各个去噪步骤中被反复重新计算，导致推理成本高昂。现有的基于缓存的方法通过跨去噪步骤复用中间结果、并在每一步仅重新计算部分位置来降低这一成本，其中位置的选择要么基于固定的时间表，要么基于变化的启发式信号。我们的轨迹实验则表明，解码轨迹才是更相关的量。当缓存生成保持接近全去噪轨迹时，其结果仍然准确，误差集中在去掩码顺序偏离的位置，并且随着更长参考前缀被恢复而减小。这提示了一个更直接的原则：限制表示误差虽然有帮助，但让生成保持在全去噪轨迹上是实现准确解码更直接的途径。因此，我们提出了……（原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文通过轨迹实验发现缓存生成保持接近全去噪轨迹是准确解码的关键，据此提出TraceQuery方法，从全去噪轨迹中学习每一步需要重新计算哪些位置，从而在大幅降低扩散语言模型推理成本的同时保证解码准确性。
en_tdlr: TraceQuery learns what to recompute at each denoising step by keeping cached generation aligned with the full-denoising trajectory, enabling accurate decoding in diffusion language models at significantly reduced inference cost.
